title: Vector Fields and Line Integrals: Work, Circulation, and Flux
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Line Integral of a Vector Field (Work)
definitions.latex: W = \int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = \int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot \mathbf{T} \, ds = \int_C M \, dx + N \, dy + P \, dz
definitions.statement: The line integral of vector field F along oriented curve C measures the cumulative tangential component of F along C. In physics, it represents the work done by force field F moving a particle along C.
conditions: F is continuous along oriented smooth curve C
definitions.explanation: Evaluating F . dr = (M x' + N y' + P z') dt contracts vector dot products into a single definite integral.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Reversing orientation negates the value: int_{-C} F . dr = - int_C F . dr.

definitions.title: Circulation and Flux in the Plane
definitions.latex: \text{Circulation} = \oint_C \mathbf{F} \cdot \mathbf{T} \, ds = \oint_C M \, dx + N \, dy, \quad \text{Flux} = \oint_C \mathbf{F} \cdot \mathbf{n} \, ds = \oint_C M \, dy - N \, dx
definitions.statement: Along a closed planar curve C, circulation measures the net fluid flow around the loop, while flux measures the net fluid flow passing outward through the boundary curve.
conditions: C is a simple closed curve with counterclockwise orientation
definitions.explanation: Outward normal n = T x k turns the unit tangent 90 degrees clockwise, converting F . n ds into M dy - N dx.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Circulation evaluates boundary alignment; flux evaluates boundary penetration.
